entries.title: Isaiah 44:1
segments: ¶"Yet hear now, O Jacob My servant, And Israel whom I have chosen.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:2
segments: Thus says the LORD who made you And formed you from the womb, [who] will help you: 'Fear not, O Jacob My servant; And you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:3
segments: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, And floods on the dry ground; I will pour My Spirit on your descendants, And My blessing on your offspring;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:4
segments: They will spring up among the grass Like willows by the watercourses.'

entries.title: Isaiah 44:5
segments: One will say, 'I [am] the LORD'S'; Another will call [himself] by the name of Jacob; Another will write [with] his hand, 'The LORD'S,' And name [himself] by the name of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:6
segments: "Thus says the LORD, the King of Israel, And his Redeemer, the LORD of hosts: 'I [am] the First and I [am] the Last; Besides Me [there is] no God.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:7
segments: And who can proclaim as I do? Then let him declare it and set it in order for Me, Since I appointed the ancient people. And the things that are coming and shall come, Let them show these to them.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:8
segments: Do not fear, nor be afraid; Have I not told you from that time, and declared [it]? You [are] My witnesses. Is there a God besides Me? Indeed [there is] no other Rock; I know not [one].'"

entries.title: Isaiah 44:9
segments: ¶Those who make an image, all of them [are] useless, And their precious things shall not profit; They [are] their own witnesses; They neither see nor know, that they may be ashamed.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:10
segments: Who would form a god or mold an image [That] profits him nothing?

entries.title: Isaiah 44:11
segments: Surely all his companions would be ashamed; And the workmen, they [are] mere men. Let them all be gathered together, Let them stand up; Yet they shall fear, They shall be ashamed together.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:12
segments: The blacksmith with the tongs works one in the coals, Fashions it with hammers, And works it with the strength of his arms. Even so, he is hungry, and his strength fails; He drinks no water and is faint.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:13
segments: The craftsman stretches out [his] rule, He marks one out with chalk; He fashions it with a plane, He marks it out with the compass, And makes it like the figure of a man, According to the beauty of a man, that it may remain in the house.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:14
segments: He cuts down cedars for himself, And takes the cypress and the oak; He secures [it] for himself among the trees of the forest. He plants a pine, and the rain nourishes [it].

entries.title: Isaiah 44:15
segments: Then it shall be for a man to burn, For he will take some of it and warm himself; Yes, he kindles [it] and bakes bread; Indeed he makes a god and worships [it]; He makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:16
segments: He burns half of it in the fire; With this half he eats meat; He roasts a roast, and is satisfied. He even warms [himself] and says, "Ah! I am warm, I have seen the fire."

entries.title: Isaiah 44:17
segments: And the rest of it he makes into a god, His carved image. He falls down before it and worships [it], Prays to it and says, "Deliver me, for you [are] my god!"

entries.title: Isaiah 44:18
segments: They do not know nor understand; For He has shut their eyes, so that they cannot see, [And] their hearts, so that they cannot understand.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:19
segments: And no one considers in his heart, Nor [is there] knowledge nor understanding to say, "I have burned half of it in the fire, Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals; I have roasted meat and eaten [it]; And shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down before a block of wood?"

entries.title: Isaiah 44:20
segments: He feeds on ashes; A deceived heart has turned him aside; And he cannot deliver his soul, Nor say, "[Is there] not a lie in my right hand?"

entries.title: Isaiah 44:21
segments: ¶"Remember these, O Jacob, And Israel, for you [are] My servant; I have formed you, you [are] My servant; O Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me!

entries.title: Isaiah 44:22
segments: I have blotted out, like a thick cloud, your transgressions, And like a cloud, your sins. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you."

entries.title: Isaiah 44:23
segments: Sing, O heavens, for the LORD has done [it]! Shout, you lower parts of the earth; Break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest, and every tree in it! For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, And glorified Himself in Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 44:24
segments: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, And He who formed you from the womb: "I [am] the LORD, who makes all [things], Who stretches out the heavens all alone, Who spreads abroad the earth by Myself;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:25
segments: Who frustrates the signs of the babblers, And drives diviners mad; Who turns wise men backward, And makes their knowledge foolishness;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:26
segments: Who confirms the word of His servant, And performs the counsel of His messengers; Who says to Jerusalem, 'You shall be inhabited,' To the cities of Judah, 'You shall be built,' And I will raise up her waste places;

entries.title: Isaiah 44:27
segments: Who says to the deep, 'Be dry! And I will dry up your rivers';

entries.title: Isaiah 44:28
segments: Who says of Cyrus, '[He is] My shepherd, And he shall perform all My pleasure, Saying to Jerusalem, "You shall be built," And to the temple, "Your foundation shall be laid."'
